create_benchmarks_from_uris: create a Benchmarks model from a list of benchmark URIs for training or validation
create_benchmarks_from_dataset: create a Benchmarks model from a dataset name with a max_benchmarks limit
iterate_benchmarks: iterate over Benchmark objects using benchmarks_iterator with a CompilerEnv instance
iterate_benchmark_uris: iterate over benchmark URI strings using benchmark_uris_iterator with a CompilerEnv instance
validate_benchmark_uris: validate benchmark URIs using the pydantic validator that checks scheme and dataset fields
